# Ergodyne

> > Ergodyne manufactures workplace safety equipment and personal protective equipment (PPE) including hi-vis apparel, safety eyewear, head protection, cooling gear, knee pads, back supports, and tool storage solutions.

Ergodyne offers multiple product lines including GloWear (hi-vis safety apparel), Skullerz (head and eye protection), ProFlex (ergonomic supports and knee pads), Chill-Its (cooling and heat stress solutions), Arsenal (tool storage), Squids (drop prevention), and Krewd (sun protection). Products meet ANSI, OSHA, and international safety standards including ANSI/ISEA 107-2020, ANSI Z87.1-2020, and California Proposition 65 compliance.

## Key Topics

- ANSI/ISEA certified safety equipment
- Hi-vis safety apparel and vests
- Skullerz head and eye protection
- Fog-Off+ anti-fog technology
- GloWear high-visibility workwear
- ProFlex ergonomic supports and knee pads
- Arsenal tool storage and organization
- Squids drop prevention solutions
- Chill-Its cooling and heat stress gear
- 1680D ballistic polyester construction
- ANSI/ISEA 107-2020 compliance
- ANSI/ISEA Z87.1-2020 eye protection standards
- California Proposition 65 compliance
- Impact-resistant and UV-protection features
- Workplace safety and PPE solutions
